arguments.operations:
logoFrame=I(document, {type:'frame', name:'03_Logo Usage', layout:'vertical', width:1440, height:900, fill:'#FFFFFF', padding:[64,80], gap:40, x:3040, y:0})
header=I(logoFrame, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:'fill_container', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'space-between'})
kitLabel=I(header, {type:'text', content:'BRANDING VI KIT', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:11, fontWeight:'700', fill:'#71717A'})
pageNum=I(header, {type:'text', content:'03 / 05', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:11, fontWeight:'500', fill:'#71717A'})
divider=I(logoFrame, {type:'rectangle', width:'fill_container', height:1, fill:'#E4E4E7'})
titleRow=I(logoFrame, {type:'frame', layout:'vertical', width:'fill_container', gap:8})
pageTitle=I(titleRow, {type:'text', content:'Logo Usage', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:40, fontWeight:'700', fill:'#0D0D0D'})
pageDesc=I(titleRow, {type:'text', content:'Logo versions, clear space rules and prohibited usage guidelines', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:16, fill:'#71717A'})
logoContent=I(logoFrame, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:'fill_container', gap:32, alignItems:'start'})
versionsCol=I(logoContent, {type:'frame', layout:'vertical', width:'fill_container', gap:16})
versionsLabel=I(versionsCol, {type:'text', content:'LOGO VERSIONS', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:11, fontWeight:'700', fill:'#71717A'})
versionsRow=I(versionsCol, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:'fill_container', gap:16})
logoPrimary=I(versionsRow, {type:'frame', layout:'vertical', width:220, height:140, cornerRadius:8, fill:'#FAFAFA', stroke:{thickness:1, fill:'#E4E4E7', align:'inside'}, alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center', gap:12})
logoMark=I(logoPrimary, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:48, height:48, cornerRadius:12, fill:'#7C3AED', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'})
logoMarkInner=I(logoMark, {type:'text', content:'V', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:24, fontWeight:'800', fill:'#D0F300'})
logoText=I(logoPrimary, {type:'text', content:'VISIONIX', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:18, fontWeight:'800', fill:'#0D0D0D'})
logoPrimaryLabel=I(versionsCol, {type:'text', content:'Primary — Light Background', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:12, fill:'#71717A'})
logoDark=I(versionsRow, {type:'frame', layout:'vertical', width:220, height:140, cornerRadius:8, fill:'#0D0D0D', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center', gap:12})
logoMarkDark=I(logoDark, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:48, height:48, cornerRadius:12, fill:'#7C3AED', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'})
logoMarkInnerDark=I(logoMarkDark, {type:'text', content:'V', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:24, fontWeight:'800', fill:'#D0F300'})
logoTextDark=I(logoDark, {type:'text', content:'VISIONIX', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:18, fontWeight:'800', fill:'#FFFFFF'})
logoDarkLabel=I(versionsCol, {type:'text', content:'Reversed — Dark Background', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:12, fill:'#71717A'})
clearSpaceCol=I(logoContent, {type:'frame', layout:'vertical', width:320, gap:16})
clearSpaceLabel=I(clearSpaceCol, {type:'text', content:'CLEAR SPACE RULES', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:11, fontWeight:'700', fill:'#71717A'})
clearSpaceBox=I(clearSpaceCol, {type:'frame', layout:'vertical', width:280, height:200, cornerRadius:8, fill:'#F4F4F5', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center', gap:8})
csDiagramOuter=I(clearSpaceBox, {type:'frame', width:160, height:120, cornerRadius:4, stroke:{thickness:1, fill:'#7C3AED', align:'inside'}, fill:'#EDE9FE', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'})
csDiagramInner=I(csDiagramOuter, {type:'frame', width:120, height:80, cornerRadius:4, fill:'#7C3AED', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'})
csDiagramText=I(csDiagramInner, {type:'text', content:'LOGO', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:12, fontWeight:'700', fill:'#FFFFFF'})
clearSpaceNote=I(clearSpaceCol, {type:'text', content:'Minimum clear space: 1x logo height on all sides', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:12, fill:'#71717A'})
prohibitedCol=I(logoContent, {type:'frame', layout:'vertical', width:280, gap:16})
prohibitedLabel=I(prohibitedCol, {type:'text', content:'PROHIBITED USAGE', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:11, fontWeight:'700', fill:'#71717A'})
prule1=I(prohibitedCol, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:'fill_container', gap:12, alignItems:'center'})
prule1dot=I(prule1, {type:'ellipse', width:8, height:8, fill:'#EF4444'})
prule1text=I(prule1, {type:'text', content:'Do not stretch or distort', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:13, fill:'#0D0D0D'})
prule2=I(prohibitedCol, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:'fill_container', gap:12, alignItems:'center'})
prule2dot=I(prule2, {type:'ellipse', width:8, height:8, fill:'#EF4444'})
prule2text=I(prule2, {type:'text', content:'Do not change brand colors', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:13, fill:'#0D0D0D'})
prule3=I(prohibitedCol, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:'fill_container', gap:12, alignItems:'center'})
prule3dot=I(prule3, {type:'ellipse', width:8, height:8, fill:'#EF4444'})
prule3text=I(prule3, {type:'text', content:'Do not use low-contrast backgrounds', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:13, fill:'#0D0D0D'})
prule4=I(prohibitedCol, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:'fill_container', gap:12, alignItems:'center'})
prule4dot=I(prule4, {type:'ellipse', width:8, height:8, fill:'#EF4444'})
prule4text=I(prule4, {type:'text', content:'Do not add shadows or effects', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:13, fill:'#0D0D0D'})
prule5=I(prohibitedCol, {type:'frame', layout:'horizontal', width:'fill_container', gap:12, alignItems:'center'})
prule5dot=I(prule5, {type:'ellipse', width:8, height:8, fill:'#EF4444'})
prule5text=I(prule5, {type:'text', content:'Minimum size: 24px height', fontFamily:'Manrope', fontSize:13, fill:'#0D0D0D'})
